_readme: Artefacts that differ between two captures of an UNCHANGED site.
Each entry must record how it was proven flaky rather than caused by the
change under test. The proof is always the same control experiment:
capture the same page twice with the change REVERTED. If those two
disagree, the artefact is flaky and belongs here. If they agree, the
difference is real and does not.
Listed artefacts are still compared and their pixel counts still reported
-- they just do not fail the run. That is deliberate: suppressing them
silently would hide a genuine regression that later lands on the same
artefact. Keep this list as short as the evidence allows, and re-test
Markup is never suppressed. A markup change on a flaky artefact still

our-team@desktop.png.reason: Elementor motion-fx decorative dot layer renders its background at a slightly different scale between runs. The transform is already pinned by FREEZE_CSS and the markup is byte-identical, so what varies is how the layer's background is scaled against a container whose height settles marginally differently.
our-team@desktop.png.provenNotOurs: baseline vs a fresh capture with piecyfer-core DEACTIVATED also differs, so no change of ours is involved.
our-team@desktop.png.retest2026-08-14: No longer reproduces between two current captures: the cc4-a vs cc4-b control is identical on all 24 screenshots. It still differs against `baseline`, which was captured before the harness cleared Elementor's element cache and before the resize dispatch moved inside the settle loop. Kept until a cache-cleared reference snapshot exists to compare against; if it stays quiet there, delete this entry rather than carrying it forward.
